provenance.title: 315 High Complexity Files
provenance.metric: architectureIssues["N High Complexity Files"] — analyzed files where calcComplexity(content).level === "critical", i.e. 1 + Σ(branch-regex hits) > 30 over the RAW file text, comments and string literals included (index.html:1663-1685, 5453-5454)
provenance.sampleNote: the filed finding names 315 files and cites 5 of them by bare file name (agent-comment.ts, codeflow-fp-filter.test.mts, entrypoint.sh, fp-filter.js, git-issue-create-external-skill.test.mts) — the only two shared with the other drafted issues are the fp-filter pair. Each bare name is resolved here to its single tracked path.
provenance.scoreNote: the mirror scores RAW text, so branch-shaped English in a comment (`and`, `or`, `if `) counts. Deleting the security rationale to lower the number is not a refactor; the `after` scores below are what the delivered files measure.
